panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: HTTP requests answered per second, all surfaces.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a server error.

panels.title: S3 circuit breaker
panels.description: Open while S3 is considered down (only with the local blob cache).

panels.title: Oldest due delete
panels.description: How long the oldest due S3 delete of the outbox has been waiting.

panels.title: Running builds
panels.description: The version each instance runs.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: HTTP requests being handled now.

panels.title: Repositories
panels.description: Repositories of every format and kind (the inventory worker's last count).

panels.title: Requests by surface
panels.description: Requests per second by surface (the route a request matched).

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second by status class.

panels.title: Latency p95 by surface
panels.description: 95th percentile time to response headers (a download's body is not included).

panels.title: Response bytes by surface
panels.description: Response body bytes sent per second.

panels.title: Lookups by outcome
panels.description: Proxy lookups per second by outcome, for the selected repositories.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by repository
panels.description: Lookups answered from the cache, per proxy repository.

panels.title: Upstream errors by repository
panels.description: Lookups that failed because the upstream could not be reached or answered an error.

panels.title: Upstream 429s by repository
panels.description: Upstream answers 429 Too Many Requests (Docker Hub's pull limit).

panels.title: Upstream latency p95 by repository
panels.description: 95th percentile time to an upstream's response headers.

panels.title: Bytes fetched from upstreams
panels.description: Bytes proxy repositories fetched from their upstreams per second.

panels.title: S3 operations by outcome
panels.description: S3 operations per second by outcome (breaker_open: refused while S3 is down).

panels.title: S3 latency p95 by operation
panels.description: 95th percentile S3 operation time.

panels.title: Blob cache hit ratio
panels.description: Reads served from the local blob cache (with [blob_cache]).

panels.title: Blob cache size
panels.description: Bytes in each instance's local blob cache; its limit is forge_blob_cache_limit_bytes.

panels.title: Staging space in use
panels.description: Staged pushes and proxy downloads against server.max_staging_bytes.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Deferred S3 deletes not processed yet, and those of them that are due.

panels.title: Blobs deleted by GC
panels.description: Blobs deleted from S3, by the outbox worker or the orphan reconciler.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by tier
panels.description: In-process (L1) and Redis (L2) cache lookups that hit.

panels.title: Cache invalidations
panels.description: Invalidations made here and received from other instances over the backplane.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Pooled connections in use and idle, against the pools' maximum (all instances).

panels.title: Connection acquire p95
panels.description: 95th percentile wait for a pooled database connection.

panels.title: Time since last successful pass
panels.description: Seconds since each background worker last completed a pass (compare forge_worker_interval_seconds).

panels.title: Failed passes
panels.description: Worker passes that failed.

panels.title: Pass duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time a worker's pass took.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Worker loops restarted after a panic or exit.

panels.title: Versions removed
panels.description: Versions retention unlisted or deleted.

panels.title: Bytes freed by repository
panels.description: Bytes retention runs removed from each repository.

panels.title: Sign-ins by outcome
panels.description: Password sign-ins (through the realms) and OIDC logins, by realm type and outcome.

panels.title: Throttled password attempts
panels.description: Password attempts the login throttle refused.

panels.title: Token exchanges
panels.description: Trusted-publishing token exchanges by outcome.

panels.title: Identity provider errors
panels.description: Failed JWKS fetches and credential-forwarding upstreams that could not decide.

panels.title: Repositories by format and kind
panels.description: Counted by each instance's inventory worker.

panels.title: Largest repositories
panels.description: Stored bytes and versions (package versions, image tags, files) per repository.
